name: Candidate surfaces offer-letter-delay anxiety mid-interview instead of at close

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm a senior data engineer with 5 years building ETL platforms. Quick thing — when will I get the written offer letter? I have an exploding offer from another company.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: We'll get to that at close. For now — what are you looking for in this role?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Honestly, how much time will I have to decide? My other offer expires Friday.
